title: Loop-invariant, duplicated locals (exampleOriginal / originalFull / groupPrefix) recomputed every iteration inside toggleSegmentStrip
description: Inside `for (const col of row.concreteColumns)`, the code recomputes exampleOriginal = row.concreteColumns[0], originalFull = exampleOriginal (an exact alias), and groupPrefix = topPrefix(originalFull) on every iteration. None depends on the loop variable `col`; all concrete columns of a PatternRow share the same top prefix by construction (they map to one pattern with one topPrefix). exampleOriginal and originalFull are identical, and the whole block is loop-invariant, so it should be hoisted above the loop and the redundant alias removed.
evidence: Lines 226-228: `const exampleOriginal = row.concreteColumns[0]; const originalFull = exampleOriginal; const groupPrefix = topPrefix(originalFull)`. exampleOriginal is referenced nowhere except to initialise originalFull; originalFull is used only to compute groupPrefix. groupPrefix is then used at 233, 250, 251, 260, 261 -- but its value is constant across iterations because buildGroups (66-70) groups by topPrefix(pat), so every col in concreteColumns yields the same topPrefix.
behavior_preservation: Pure refactor: hoist `const groupPrefix = topPrefix(row.concreteColumns[0])` above the loop and delete the exampleOriginal/originalFull aliases; identical values are produced for every iteration, so all downstream branches behave identically.
